descriptionChirho: A young male donkey or foal; includes singular, plural, construct, and pronominal suffix forms. Used of donkeys in contexts of livestock possession (Genesis 32:15), prophecy (Zechariah 9:9), and poetic blessing (Genesis 49:11).
Homograph of the same consonantal form meaning 'town' or 'city'; occurs in Judges 10:4 referring to the towns of Jair. A distinct lexeme from the donkey sense, sharing only the written form.
